newsitem.title: USA: Modine adjusts price of preferred rights.
newsitem.headline: Modine adjusts price of preferred rights.

text.p: Modine Manufacturing Co said Thursday its board adjusted the purchase price of one one-hundredth of a share of Series A participating preferred stock to $95 from $21.25.

Each share of the company's common stock carries one right that entitles the holder to buy a unit of one one-hundredth of this preferred stock, commonly known as a "poison pill" defense for hostile takeovers.
The distribution of rights was made on October 27, 1986, and earlier this year, the expiration date was extended to October 27, 2006.
Modine, a developer of heat-transfer technology, said its action was not taken in response to any specific effort to acquire control of the company, and the board is unaware of any such effort.
